intro: North York's stretch of Yonge Street is one long food court of Korean, Japanese and Persian spots, and Bathurst & Wilson is home to Little Manila. Here's where we'd start.

picks.name: Daldongnae Korean BBQ
picks.why: Grill-at-your-table Korean barbecue with plenty of side dishes. A reliable crowd-pleaser for groups.

picks.name: Kenzo
picks.why: Long-running North York ramen shop known for rich, hearty bowls — a go-to on a cold evening.

picks.name: The Fry - Sheppard
picks.why: Korean fried chicken, double-fried and glazed. Order more than you think you need.

picks.name: Pancer's Original Deli
picks.why: A Jewish deli serving towering smoked meat sandwiches since the 1950s. A true neighbourhood institution.

picks.name: Tinuno
picks.why: Filipino kamayan-style feasts served on banana leaves and eaten by hand. Fun for a group.

picks.name: Kiva's
picks.why: Bagels and bakery classics — perfect when dinner should be easy and carb-forward.
